props.description: You have learned to channel your vital force into your attacks. You may use an action to perform a Shadow Strike: roll your current Might die and lose an amount of Hit Points equal to 【the number rolled on your Might die】. If this didn't reduce your Hit Points to 0, you may perform a free attack with a weapon you have equipped: if this attack hits one or more targets, it deals extra damage equal to 【SL + the number rolled on your Might die】. However, all damage dealt by this attack becomes dark and its damage type cannot be changed.

props.description:
When you hit a creature with an attack, if that attack only targeted that creature and you have a Bond towards them, you may choose to spend half of your current Hit Points, rounded down. If you do, the attack deals extra damage equal to 【10 multiplied by the strength of your Bond towards the target】.

You may use this Skill only on your turn during a conflict, and only once per turn
props.heroic_requirement: You must have mastered the Darkblade Class.

props.description: As long as you are in Crisis, you have Resistance to dark damage and poison damage.
props.name: Dark Blood

props.description:
When you resolve the Double Trouble effect, you may have all of its damage become Light or Dark (instead of being a type of damage matching the suits of the resolved cards).

Additionally, as long as there is a joker in your discard pile, all damage dealt by your 【💥Blinding Flush】, 【💥Double Trouble】, and 【💥Magic Flush】 effects ignores Immunities and Resistances.
props.heroic_requirement: you must have mastered one or more Classes among Ace of Cards, Darkblade, Entropist, and Spiritist, and you must have acquired the Magic Cards Skill
props.name: Black & White

props.description:
After another creature causes you to lose Hit Points (with an attack, a spell or any other method), you may immediately perform the Study action on that creature for free. If you do, gain a bonus equal to 【SL】 to your Check.

Remember, you can study the same aspect of a creature only once

props.description:
As long as you are suffering from one or more status effects, you gain the following effects:

  • +1 bonus on all Checks for every status effect you are suffering from (up to a maximum of +3),

  • You deal 2 extra damage for every status effect you are suffering from (be it with attacks, spells, Arcana, items or any other method; up to a maximum of 6 extra damage).

props.class_lore:
Darkblades are somber and powerful warriors who hide a sorrowful past. Due to tragic experiences on the battlefield or in personal life, their souls have developed an affinity for pain and shadow energy.

An unlikely hero to say the very least, a Darkblade may now sacrifice their lifeforce to unleash mighty attacks and is able to draw resolve, power and even knowledge from the suffering they experience.
